request: 课程笔记作为默认开启、可关闭的弹幕显示
scope: Only current authenticated member notes via existing private /notes?video_id endpoint; no social/public sharing and no backend schema change

behavior.switch: Player overlay 弹幕 开/关; notes tab also exposes toggle on iOS/Harmony
behavior.timeline: 8s window per timestamp, maximum3 simultaneous notes; position derived from media clock so pause/seek/loop follow playback
behavior.content: Display up to120 characters on one line; original stored note unchanged
behavior.reload: On entering lesson and after saving note, with manual retry on load error
behavior.accountSafety: Session/lesson/request identity guards drop stale responses; no personal notes in public shared cache
behavior.protection: Screen capture/video protection preserved; iOS hides notes while capture blocks video

checks.iOS: Physical development build passed; Core23 groups zero failures including time boundaries, invalid time, replay/seek state and density
checks.iPhoneInstall: Updated development test bundle installed; current session preserved
checks.runtime: Actual private-note playback and per-platform inline/fullscreen visual acceptance not completed. Harmony native full-screen overlay behavior specifically requires runtime verification. Synthetic checks are not device proof. No real user notes created/edited/deleted to manufacture evidence.

release: No store upload/submission; existing release candidates, bundle IDs, signatures/filing and production flags unchanged
